# Levels

The severity levels, their names, and the level compiled into a build.

<h2 id="level"><code>Level</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum Level: uint8 {
    Trace = 0,
    Debug = 1,
    Info = 2,
    Warn = 3,
    Error = 4
}
```

How severe a record is, from the most detailed to the most serious. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Level.rux#L7)

**Cases**

| Name    | Value | Description                                              |
| ------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Trace` | `0`   | The finest detail, for following a program step by step. |
| `Debug` | `1`   | Detail for diagnosing a problem.                         |
| `Info`  | `2`   | The ordinary progress of a program.                      |
| `Warn`  | `3`   | Something unexpected that the program recovered from.    |
| `Error` | `4`   | Something that failed.                                   |

**Associated functions**

<h3 id="parse"><code>Parse</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Parse(text: char8[..]) -> Level?
```

The level named `text`, in any case; `warning` is read as `warn`.

| Name   | Type        | Description |
| ------ | ----------- | ----------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]` | the name    |

**Returns**: the level, or `none` for a name that is not one

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Level.rux#L51)

**Methods**

<h3 id="name"><code>Name</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Name(self: &Level) -> char8[..]
```

The level's name in lower case, as JSON records give it: `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`.

**Returns**: the name

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Level.rux#L24)

<h3 id="label"><code>Label</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Label(self: &Level) -> char8[..]
```

The level's label in upper case and five columns wide, as text records give it.

**Returns**: the label

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Level.rux#L37)

<h2 id="compiled-level"><code>CompiledLevel</code></h2>

```rux
pub func CompiledLevel() -> Level
```

The least severe level this build keeps, from the `LogLevel` build define: `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn` or
`error`, and `trace` when it is not defined. A record below it is dropped before anything about it is done,
whatever level a logger is set to, so a release build can leave out its tracing entirely.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Level.rux#L79)

**Returns**: the level
